title: Oracle-Budgeted Protein Design with Stochastic Search and Iterative Imitation
abstract: arXiv:2605.26690v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Optimizing protein sequences under tight oracle budgets requires methods that can explore a vast combinatorial mutational search space. These methods must also remain robust in the presence of surrogate noise and propose mutations on positions where substitutions are predicted to have favorable effects. We introduce SILO (Self-improvement Imitation Learning Optimization), a trajectory-level approach for oracle-budgeted protein design. SILO combines a hierarchical edit policy with incremental stochastic beam search without replacement (SBS) to explore diverse candidate trajectories. A UCB-based proxy ensemble, complemented by a proxy-derived alanine-scan-inspired fitness score (AFS), guides candidate selection for in silico oracle evaluation. The policy is then updated by next-action cross-entropy imitation on the round's best oracle-labeled trajectories. Across eight in silico protein fitness landscapes and five strong baseline

translated_title: 基于随机搜索与迭代模仿的预言机预算蛋白质设计
translated_abstract: 在严格的预言机（评估）预算下优化蛋白质序列，需要能够探索庞大组合突变搜索空间的方法。这些方法还必须在代理模型噪声存在的情况下保持稳健，并在预测替换具有有利效果的位点上提出突变。我们提出了SILO（自我改进模仿学习优化），一种面向预言机预算蛋白质设计的轨迹级方法。SILO将层次化编辑策略与无放回的增量随机束搜索（SBS）相结合，以探索多样化的候选轨迹。基于UCB的代理模型集成，辅以受丙氨酸扫描启发的代理衍生适应度评分（AFS），指导候选选择以进行计算机内的预言机评估。随后，通过对当轮最佳预言机标注轨迹进行下一动作交叉熵模仿来更新策略。在八个计算机模拟蛋白质适应度景观和五个强基线方法上（原文摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: SILO是一种轨迹级蛋白质设计方法，结合层次化编辑策略与随机束搜索探索多样化突变轨迹，利用UCB代理集成与丙氨酸扫描式适应度评分筛选候选序列，并通过交叉熵模仿学习迭代自我改进，在严格的预言机评估预算下高效优化蛋白质序列。
